A '''Weequay pirate ship''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used for transport and operated by [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a Weequay pirate ship known as the [[Marauder (Weequay pirate ship)/Legends|''Marauder'']] was used as a gladiatorial fighting arena for [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. It was later used as target practice by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]] and was destroyed.
Another Weequay pirate ship was seen on [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] seconds before [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] landed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
